notes: Primitive layer: raw values. Never reference primitives directly in components — use the semantic layer.
Semantic layer: every token is an alias into the primitive layer using {group.token} syntax.
Alpha hex values follow 8-digit RRGGBBAA notation.
font/size/root is a code-only anchor for the Responsive collection, not a type style token.
Responsive collection (Device Width, Scale, Device) are build-config references, not design tokens, and are omitted.
Homie/Inkwell and Homie/Eyes are orphaned primitives not referenced by any semantic token.
Text styles: letterSpacing is not variable-bound in Figma (API limitation). Values are raw percent.

page.$description: Root screen canvas. Every screen's base background.

surface.$description: Elevated container fill. Cards, bottom sheets, modals, dropdowns.

input.$description: Editable field fill. Text inputs, textareas, search fields at rest.

contrast.$description: Light surface on the dark page. Tooltips, toasts that must read as light against page.

elevated.$description: Additive white overlay for subtle lift. Toasts, snackbars a step above surface.

floating.$description: Translucent floating surface. Dropdowns, tooltips, popovers with frosted-glass effect.

scrim.$description: Semi-transparent overlay behind modals, dialogs, bottom sheets.

primary.$description: Primary CTA fill. One per screen. Pair with interactive.label.primary.

secondary.$description: Secondary action fill. Skip, Cancel, filter chips.

disabled.$description: Unavailable control fill. Apply to the whole component, not just text.

pressed.$description: Tap feedback overlay on light or vivid surfaces. Layer over resting fill.

pressedInverse.$description: Tap feedback overlay on dark surfaces. Layer over secondary or card fills.

primary.$description: Text and icons inside a primary button. Pair with interactive.primary.

secondary.$description: Text and icons inside a secondary button. Pair with interactive.secondary.

primary.$description: Default body and heading text. Maximum contrast on dark backgrounds.

tertiary.$description: Lowest readable emphasis. Inline hints, counts, timestamps.

disabled.$description: Unavailable or placeholder text. Pair with interactive.disabled.

inverse.$description: Dark text on light or vivid surfaces. Pair with background.contrast.

on-brand.$description: Violet-tinted dark text on accent.brand.bold surfaces. Not interchangeable with text.inverse.

error.$description: Validation error message text below a failed field.

warning.$description: Caution text. One attempt left, expiry notices.

default.$description: Standard container edge. Cards, dividers, resting inputs.

strong.$description: Higher contrast edge. Dividers on busy surfaces.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring. Always visible. Pair with stroke.heavy-border at 2px.

selected.$description: Edge of a chosen element. Selected cards, active tabs.

error.$description: Invalid input edge. Pair with text.error.

surface.$description: Fill of a chosen element. Selected answer cards, active tabs.

border.$description: Edge of a chosen element. Always pair with state.selected.surface, never alone.

primary.$description: Knowie mascot body fill. Illustration use only.

eyes.$description: Knowie eye whites. Illustration use only.

glow.$description: Glow around Knowie while listening. Matches Figma mascot/glow exactly.

idle.$description: Voice FAB halo at rest. mascot/primary at 15%.

sent.$description: Voice FAB halo on send. mascot/primary at 20%.

bold.$description: PRO badge and upgrade banner fill.
Text on pro.bold. Pair with pro.bold.

subtle.$description: Text on pro.subtle. Pair with pro.subtle.

bold.$description: Solid brand violet. Brand moments, onboarding hero panels.
Text on accent.brand.bold.
Decorative green. Streak counters, positive stat chips. Not for validation.
Text on accent.green.bold.

subtle.$description: Tinted green background. Behind positive stat chips.

bold.$description: Decorative coral. Category tags, illustration accents. Not for errors.
Text on accent.coral.bold.
Decorative blue. Informational chips, secondary category tags.
Text on accent.blue.bold.
Decorative magenta. Category tags.
Text on accent.magenta.bold.
Correct answer fill. Completion states. Not for decorative green.
Text on feedback.success.bold.

subtle.$description: Tinted background behind a correct result.
Success wash. 20% green tile and icon-container fills. summarySmallCards, strongCard.

bold.$description: Incorrect answer fill. Failed validation. Not for destructive buttons.
Text on feedback.error.bold.

subtle.$description: Tinted background behind a wrong result.
Error wash. 20% red tile fill. feedbackButton verdict=Misheard, summarySmallCards review tile.

bold.$description: Warning fill. One attempt left chips, time-pressure banners.
Text on feedback.warning.bold.

subtle.$description: Tinted background behind a warning chip or banner.

bold.$description: Almost there fill. Distinguishes partial from success (green) and error (red).
Text on feedback.partial.bold.

subtle.$description: Tinted background behind a partial result card.

bold.$description: Irreversible action fill. Delete, remove, block buttons at rest.
Text on feedback.destructive.bold.

fontFamily.$description: Display L — hero moments only, one per screen.

letterSpacing.$description: Display L tracking: -1% (not variable-bound in Figma).

fontFamily.$description: Display M — large numeric stats, XP totals.
Display S — scores, countdowns, prominent single-line results.
Headline XL — primary screen titles. One per screen.
Headline L — section headings, modal titles, recall prompt terms.
Headline M — sub-section titles, stat tile labels.

lineHeight.$description: Headline M line-height: 32px. Note: not variable-bound in Figma (font/lineHeight variable missing for this step).

fontFamily.$description: Headline S — card headings, bottom sheet titles, step labels.
Headline XS Bold — emphasized sub-headings, chip labels, tab labels.
Headline XS Regular — paired with XS Bold for mixed-weight headings.
Headline XXS Bold — small card labels, badge text, list item titles.
Headline XXS Regular — secondary list items, supporting labels.
Body M Bold — emphasized body copy, key terms in recall prompts.
Body M Regular — default reading style. Recall prompts, feedback text, answer cards.
Body S Bold — emphasized text in compact contexts.
Body S Regular — secondary reading copy, helper text, transcript display.
Caption M Bold — progress labels, XP counter values, stat tile units.

fontSize.$description: Caption M size: 12px. System readable minimum.

fontFamily.$description: Caption M Regular — timestamps, secondary metadata, helper text.
Caption S Bold — fine print, badge superscripts, legal text. Check WCAG contrast at 9px.

fontSize.$description: Caption S size: 9px. System fine-print minimum.

fontFamily.$description: Caption S Regular — watermarks, attribution, decorative labels.

XXS.$description: Height of an extra extra small control. Chips at size XXS.

XS.$description: Height of an extra small control. Chips at size XS.

S.$description: Height of a small control. Buttons, chips, inputs at size S.

M.$description: Height of a medium control. Buttons, chips, inputs at size M.

L.$description: Height of a large control. Buttons, chips, inputs at size L.

XXS.$description: Smallest icon on the scale. iconSlot Size=100.

XS.$description: Icon size inside an extra small control.

S.$description: Icon size inside a small control.

M.$description: Icon size inside a medium control.

L.$description: Icon size inside a large control.

XL.$description: Largest icon on the scale. iconSlot Size=400.

min.$description: Minimum tap target. Controls shorter than this keep it as a transparent hit area.

S.$description: Tallest a small bottom sheet grows to before its body scrolls.

M.$description: Tallest a medium bottom sheet grows to before its body scrolls.

L.$description: Tallest a large bottom sheet grows to before its body scrolls.

width.$description: Width of the drag handle on a bottom sheet.

height.$description: Height of the drag handle on a bottom sheet.

XL.$description: Knowie at the smallest illustration size. Inline emotional moments.

2XL.$description: Knowie at a medium illustration size.

3XL.$description: Knowie at a large illustration size.

4XL.$description: Knowie at the largest illustration size. Full-screen moments.

band.$description: Height of a card's colour band header. folderCard.

strip.$description: Height of a progress strip running along a card edge.

tab.$description: Height of the tab that sits above a folder card.

M.$description: Height of a progress bar at its standard thickness. progressIndicator thickness=24.

S.$description: Height of a progress bar at its slim thickness. progressIndicator thickness=16.

track.$description: Height of the inner track inside a standard progress bar, inset from the outer pill.

ring.$description: Outer halo of the voice FAB. Scales with fab/button — never independently.

button.$description: Tap surface of the voice FAB.

orb.$description: Voice FAB orb while recording, larger than the resting button.

glyph.$description: Mic illustration inside the voice FAB.

thinking.$description: Voice FAB orb while thinking, between the resting button and the recording orb.

ring.$description: Diameter of the session score donut. percentage.

stroke.$description: Thickness of the session score donut ring.

badge.$description: Diameter of the inline score ring beside a verdict badge.

bullet.$description: Diameter of a list bullet dot.

XXS.$description: Horizontal padding inside an extra extra small control.

XS.$description: Horizontal padding inside an extra small control.

S.$description: Horizontal padding inside a small control.

M.$description: Horizontal padding inside a medium control.

L.$description: Horizontal padding inside a large control.

XXS.$description: Gap between icon and label in an extra extra small control.

XS.$description: Gap between icon and label in an extra small control.

S.$description: Gap between icon and label in a small control.

M.$description: Gap between icon and label in a medium control.

L.$description: Gap between icon and label in a large control.

S.$description: Nudge that optically centres a label in a small control.

M.$description: Nudge that optically centres a label in a medium control.

L.$description: Nudge that optically centres a label in a large control.

XXS.$description: Hairline block-level spacing. The gap between a control and the field beside it.

XL.$description: Loose block-level spacing. Gap between sections.

2XL.$description: Widest block-level spacing. Gap between a card body and the row beneath it.

gutter.$description: The inset from the screen edge to content on a recall turn. The scaffold's slots pad 16, but every recall screenshot in reference/ draws content at 20 with a 350 column — measured on recall-processing, recall-partial, recall-correct and recall-result, which agree exactly. A role rather than a scale step, because the layout scale runs 16 then 24 with nothing between.

pill.$description: Fully rounded ends. Buttons, chips, badges.

sheet.$description: Top corners of a surface that rises from the bottom edge.

input.$description: Corners of a multi-line input once it grows past a single row.

card.$description: Corners of a card. folderCard, and surfaces that sit on the page.

tab.$description: Top corners of the tab that sits above a folder card.

inner.$description: Corners of a block nested inside a card. recallResponseCard Knowie Answer.

strip.$description: Corners of a progress or accent strip.

default.$description: Default border width. Input containers, bordered surfaces.

strong.$description: Emphasised border width. Focus rings, selected states.

blur.$description: Background blur behind a floating badge.

glow.$description: Soft outer glow behind a live control. voiceFab while recording.

blur-soft.$description: Slight defocus on a non-interactive surface. voiceFab while thinking.

border.$description: Edge of the active tab. Brighter than border/selected and off the violet scale.

instant.$description: A state flipping under the student's finger. Press feedback, a chip selecting.

quick.$description: A control answering. The orb changing state, a sheet's handle.

settle.$description: Something arriving or leaving. A verdict card, a raised sheet.

breath.$description: One cycle of a continuous loop. voiceFab while recording. Long on purpose: a fast pulse reads as urgency, and the student is meant to keep talking.

standard.$description: The default. Leaves fast, lands soft — the curve for anything the student caused.

enter.$description: Something appearing. No easing in, so it is already moving when you notice it.

continuous.$description: Loops only. Symmetric, so no frame of the cycle reads as the start.
